name: Monster Trainer Monster Performer
body:
Monster performers are almost as varied as trainers because no one type of performance can appeal to everybody. Troupes of performers, equally skilled in battle and showmanship, will sometimes adventure together and have often proven as effective as any other party thanks to the versatility they possess and the monsters they raise.

Spells Per Day

A performer gains spells per day as a bard of her monster trainer level, which means she cannot cast 7th-level or higher trainer spells, even if a monster would grant them to her. This alters the monster trainer’s spells.

Bardic Performance

Every monster performer begins play with the inspire courage bardic performance, as the bard class feature. Her effective bard level is equal to her monster trainer level.

The performer shares her ranks in Perform with her active monster, if it could reasonably use that Perform skill (a monster that cannot speak a language cannot give a speech, for example). If the performer is unable to maintain her performance, she can still direct her active monster to do so through their telepathic connection.

At 2nd level, and every even level thereafter, the performer gains another performance of her choice. The performance must be one that could be gained by a bard of the performer’s level. At 20th level, if the performer chooses deadly performance, it counts as a master perk.

This ability replaces eschew materials, favored enemy, and spell familiarity.

Tandem Training (Ex)

At 4th level, a monster performer who chooses the tactics training perk at least once shares her teamwork feats with her active monster. This ability alters the tactics training perk.

Versatile Performance (Ex)

At 9th level, a performer can choose one type of Perform skill. She can use her bonus in that skill in place of her bonus in associated skills. When substituting in this way, the performer uses her total Perform skill bonus, including class skill bonus, in place of its associated skill’s bonus, whether or not she has ranks in that skill or if it is a class skill.

The types of Perform and their associated skills are: Act (Bluff, Disguise), Comedy (Bluff, Intimidate), Dance (Acrobatics, Fly), Keyboard Instruments (Diplomacy, Intimidate), Oratory (Diplomacy, Sense Motive), Percussion (Handle Animal, Intimidate), Sing (Bluff, Sense Motive), String (Bluff, Diplomacy), and Wind (Diplomacy, Handle Animal).

This ability replaces great trainer.

Trainer Perks

The following trainer perks complement the performer archetype: Beloved monster, extraordinary channeler, improved channel monster, inspiring trainer, skilled trainer, supernatural channeler, and tactics training.
